name: United Arab Emirates

fees.name: Single-entry tourist (visit) visa - 30 days
fees.applies: eligible nationalities requiring a visa / sponsored entry permit
fees.notes: Base government fee AED 252, plus 5% VAT. GDRFA-Dubai published rate; fees are consistent across UAE federal ICP system but sponsor/typing-centre service charges add to the total actually paid by applicants.

fees.name: Single-entry tourist (visit) visa - 60 days
fees.applies: eligible nationalities requiring a visa / sponsored entry permit
fees.notes: Base government fee AED 352, plus 5% VAT. Additional charges of AED 10 Knowledge Dirham + AED 10 Innovation Dirham apply, and AED 500 extra if applicant is already inside the UAE.

fees.name: 96-hour transit visa
fees.applies: passengers transiting UAE airports needing a visa
fees.notes: 48-hour transit visa is issued free of charge for eligible transit passengers; the 96-hour transit visa carries the AED 50 government fee. Airline/agent service charges may apply on top.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.applies: passport holders of countries on the UAE's visa-on-arrival list
fees.notes: UAE grants many nationalities free entry permits/visa-on-arrival (e.g. most GCC-adjacent and many eligible passport holders receive a free 30/90-day stamp). No separate official fee schedule for a distinct 'visa on arrival' product was found beyond the standard tourist visa fees above; could not verify a specific paid VOA amount on an official source.

fees.name: Electronic travel authorisation
fees.notes: UAE does not operate a separate eTA scheme distinct from its e-visa/entry-permit system; no official eTA fee found.

fees.name: Business/multi-entry visit visa
fees.notes: ICP/GDRFA publish per-service fee cards for multiple-entry and business visit visas but the exact current AED amount could not be independently verified on an official page in this session; left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Tourist e-visa - single-entry monthly (ICP Smart Services)
fees.notes: AED 100 issuance fee; plus AED 100 application fee and AED 100 smart service fee per ICP Smart Services.

fees.name: Tourist e-visa - multiple-entry monthly (ICP Smart Services)
fees.notes: AED 200 issuance fee; plus AED 100 application fee and AED 100 smart service fee per ICP Smart Services.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates centres inside the UAE, but these serve UAE residents/citizens applying for OTHER countries' visas (e.g. Schengen, UK) outbound from the UAE. Inbound visas to enter the UAE are issued directly via the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP), GDRFA-Dubai, airlines, hotels, or licensed typing/travel agency sponsors - not through VFS Global. No evidence of VFS Global processing UAE-entry visa applications on behalf of foreign nationals was found.

free_visa_notes: UAE grants visa-free or free-of-charge visa-on-arrival entry to a large number of nationalities (varies by passport, typically 30-90 days). For nationalities that do require a paid visa, the standard tourist visa fees above (AED 252 for 30 days / AED 352 for 60 days, plus 5% VAT) apply via GDRFA/ICP sponsorship, most commonly arranged through airlines, hotels, or UAE-based sponsors rather than a self-service consumer e-visa portal.
